# OmniRoute: Stop spending fortunes on AI signatures!

OmniRoute is an open source AI gateway that brings together hundreds of model providers in a single local endpoint. The video explains the endpoint, the combos with automatic model change, routing strategies, token compression and integration with programming tools.

Video by Maurício Yokoyama Issei, published on September 3, 2026 (9 min 1 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aEjGEYzObLk

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## The chaos of APIs

Those who develop AI deal with dozens of models, SDKs and API keys, with tax limits that lock the work and without knowing the actual balance [01:23]. OmniRoute concentrates everything on a single endpoint, with automatic routing [01:45].

## A single endpoint

According to the video, OmniRoute gathers 352 AI providers behind a single entry port [02:07]. The address is the localhost on port 21028: just point the tool to this URL [02:29].

The video cites more than 150 providers with free plan and more than 1.5 billion free tokens tracked per month, without switching tools or rewriting code [02:50].

## The combo engine

A combo is a chain of models. If the favorite model leaves the air or the quota ends in the middle of the work, the combo enters as a safety net [03:33]. It works in three steps:

- The engine tries the main model [03:54].
- If this model hits a rate limit or falls, the engine redirects the request to the next healthy model of the queue [03:54].
- Everything happens in fractions of second, without manual intervention [03:54].

## Routing strategies

There are 19 routing strategies, which can be combined at each step of a combo: for example, round-robin, the least used provider at the time or the cheapest route [04:36]. The motor evaluates each candidate model with 16 factors, such as network health, remaining quota, cost and latency [04:57].

To avoid writing complex rules, there are tags ready in the model name: one for the cheapest option, one for code and auto/fast for maximum speed [05:18].

## Token compression

According to the video, Caveman mode reduces the request to 70% of the tokens [06:01]. The RTK engine added to the Caveman reduces it to 10.8% of the original, and the economy ranges from 15% to 95% [06:22].

Caveman cuts fill words and chat language, but preserves code blocks, URLs and data in JSON [06:43].

## Tool Integration

OmniRoute works with IDEs and programming agents that are already in use, such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot and Claude Code [07:24].

To start, install locally, point the tool to the localhost and write auto in the template. According to the video, no initial credit card or API keys are required [08:05].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to change my code to use OmniRoute?

According to the video, no: just point the tool to the local endpoint [02:50].

### What happens when a model reaches the limit?

Combo redirects the request to the next healthy model of the queue [03:54].

## About the video

Will you stop spending fortunes on AI subscriptions and never suffer from limits of use (rate limits) during development? In this video, we present OmniRoute, the definitive AI gateway with MIT license that unifies 352 providers (more than 150 of them with free listed tiers) and more than 1200 models (such as Claude, GPT, Gemini, Kimi, DeepSeek, and many others) in a single local endpoint compatible with the OpenAI API!

In this full tutorial, you will learn:

What is OmniRoute and how it serves as a central layer of local-first orchestration.
How to obtain up to ~1.51 Billions of free tokens per month (can reach more than ~2.13 Billions in the first month with registration bonuses!) in a consolidated and audited way from dozens of providers.
How to save 15% to 95% of tokens in your requests using the native RTK + Caveman compression pipeline.
Resilience in 3 Layers: As OmniRoute prevents your workflow from locking using circuit breakers, cooling periods of keys and temporary model locks to make automatic fallback.
How to integrate with your favorite development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, Cline, VS Code Copilot Chat, Helper and more!
